newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur still on track for 1997 goals.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur still on track for 1997 goals.

text.p: Swiss insurer Winterthur Group said business in the first five months of 1997 continued last year's positive trend and it expects a double-digit rise in its profit this year.

Winterthur chairman and chief executive Peter Spaelti also told the annual shareholders' meeting that earnings per share (EPS) should show a significant rise this year, despite the higher number of shares entitled to a dividend.
Spaelti's forecast confirms his comments on May 29 when he told a news conference that he expected to achieve double-digit rise in profits and a significant rise in the EPS.
In 1996 Winterthur reported a group net profit of 506.7 million Swiss francs and an EPS of 57 francs.
"The first five months of this year has also continued the positive trends," Spaelti said.
